messages:
ella: Heads-up — we got 3 customers today saying the PDF invoices are missing the company registration number and they need VAT broken out per line item for their AP systems. They attached examples.

mike: Can you paste one of the sample PDFs or the billing payload? :mag: 

ella: I uploaded one to the ticket, but repro steps are simple: generate invoice for account ACCT-9987 via Billing UI -> Export PDF. In the PDF header there's only the company name and address. No Reg. No VAT per-line, only a single VAT total at the bottom.

raja: This is a blocker for some EU customers that need per-line tax for their GL. We should confirm the invoice schema supports line-level tax fields.

ella: Here is the payload we send to the PDF generator (sanitized):
```json
{
  "invoice_id": "INV-2026-0422-112",
  "customer": {
    "name": "Acme GmbH",
    "address": "Rosenstrasse 1\n1010 Berlin\nGermany",
    "vat_number": "DE123456789",
    "company_reg_id": "HRB98765"
  },
  "line_items": [
    {"description": "API usage (tokens)", "quantity": 1200, "unit_price": 0.0008, "tax_rate": 0.19},
    {"description": "Dedicated capacity surcharge", "quantity": 1, "unit_price": 2500, "tax_rate": 0.00}
  ],
  "totals": {"subtotal": 2560.96, "tax_total": 228.79, "total": 2789.75},
  "po_number": "PO-5543"
}
```

sophia: Interesting — the payload includes company_reg_id and vat_number. So the issue likely lives in the PDF template mapping or the rendering microservice, not upstream.

invoicing-bot: Automatic check: PDF template v7 used for this account. Template v7 has header variable placeholders: {{customer.name}}, {{customer.address}}, {{customer.vat_number}}. It does NOT include {{customer.company_reg_id}} and line item tax is rendered as a single column with aggregated VAT.

mike: OK that explains it. Two action items: (1) add company_reg_id to header mappings for EU/UK templates, (2) add a VAT column per line (and ensure rounding rules match accounting).

raja: For the VAT per line change we should confirm downstream systems expect "tax_amount" per line vs just "tax_rate". Some customers want explicit tax amounts per line.

ella: From the three tickets: two ask for tax_amount on each line, one asks for a separate column titled "VAT (EUR)". They also expect PO number to be in the top-right, not buried in notes.

sophia: Proposed template delta: header: include company_reg_id under the company name (label: "Company reg."). Invoice table: add columns [Qty | Description | Unit price | Tax rate | Tax amount | Line total]. Footer: keep aggregated totals but show 'VAT (by rate)' breakdown too.

mike: Agree. Also ensure address formatting handles multi-line addresses (some customers include attention lines). Current renderer collapses 
 into a single line for small-width templates. That caused the spacing issues.

raja: Repro steps for eng: 1) pull template v7, 2) modify HTML/CSS to include company_reg_id placeholder and new table column, 3) run local generator against sanitized payload above, 4) compare PDF vs expected visual artifact.

ella: Legal asked to confirm label wording for company reg id. @legal-team can you confirm whether we should use "Company registration number" or the shorter "Company reg."?

legal-team: Use "Company registration number" in full for EU invoices. For UK invoices, also accept "Company reg. no." as an alternate but prefer full wording in official PDFs.

mike: Noted. Anything for localization? IE translations for FR/DE/ES?

ella: At minimum default English. We can follow up for translations — flagged as follow-up work. For now implement English labels and VAT column.

raja: One more technical note: our rounding behavior currently sums line-item tax_amounts and stores tax_total as the rounded sum. Accounting teams sometimes need per-line tax amounts rounded to 2 decimals and then summed — ensure renderer and API use the same rounding strategy. Otherwise totals won't match customers' AP systems.

mike: I'll add a small test harness that compares (sum(round(tax_amount per line, 2)) == round(tax_total,2)). If mismatch, we surface a warning in the PDF generation logs and attach both values to the ticket.

ella: Can someone pick this up today? We have an EU customer blocking payment until next invoice looks right. Priority: high.

mike: I'll take the template change and unit tests. ETA EOD.

raja: I'll handle the renderer multi-line address fix and rounding checks.

sophia: I'll update billing docs and send a short memo to sales/GTM about the change and potential impact on customers who parse PDFs.

ella: Thanks all. I'll reply to the three tickets with an ETA and link to this thread. :thumbsup:
